en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a Central European town square. Dominating the left side is an ornate town hall with a tall clock tower featuring crenellations and a smaller upper turret. The façade has Baroque and historicist details, a balcony, and a large coat of arms. Ground-floor shopfronts with arched windows and signage open onto a cobbled square. In the center-right foreground stands an elaborate street lamp and a small fountain or pump. In the background on the right rises a slender church spire. The square is lined with multi‑story historic buildings and a few pedestrians.
